results.name: hand case (Excel tabular form): Region × Product, Sum of Units — item order, case-insensitive grouping (east = East), text ignored by Sum, blank intersection empty, Grand Totals
negative shapes: a field on Rows and Columns, an out-of-range field, a source without headings, too many fields / columns, unknown function — each refused with a reason

300 random tables × specs (1–3 row fields, 0–2 column fields, 1–3 of 11 summary functions, blanks, errors, mixed text/number items, case variants, filters, totals on/off) — every shown cell equals the pandas oracle and nothing extra is shown

workbook: create on a new sheet, source formulas are calculated values, refresh after the source changes (output grows / shrinks, stale cells cleared), refuse to overwrite data or overlap the source, save/reload keeps the definition, delete clears

.xlsx round trip of the definition (hidden sheet-scoped string names, ≤255 characters each): fresh export and lossless patch of a POI workbook with its own names; openpyxl opens both, sees the names hidden; reopened pivots refresh; deleting the pivot removes the names
